description: Fixed arithmetic mean of seeds 42/43/44 of the e2000fs_calib_offset_roll recipe (original features minus suvi_t035_equatorial_area and strip_v650_dark, plus v_lag24/48/72; 900 rounds per 24-lead block; prior model + frozen per-lead offset alpha 0.25 over the last 336 training calibration origins) with the target weight of the squared error replaced: w(v) = F(v), the loc-0 lognormal CDF of the target speed, instead of the step (4 if v >= 550 km/s else 1); weights normalised to mean 1 per lead. sigma and scale are refit by maximum likelihood on each period's own pre-cutoff observed training targets. Equal 1/3 weights; no fitted weights, no labels. Official F1/F2/F3, 144h maturity. Replacement ablation: fails the preregistered 1 % gate (S +2.25 vs the step-weight row, bias +6 km/s); published on user request.

data.training_labels: y forward-filled on the target timeline (training rows only)

hyperparameters.calibration: prior model on the reference window + frozen per-lead offset = 0.25 x mean residual of the last 336 calibration origins (training data only), clip [1, 3000] before and after
hyperparameters.objective: lognormal-CDF weighted L2 (weight = F(target), normalised per lead)

target_weight.form: lognormal CDF of the target, loc 0, closed-form MLE on pre-cutoff observed training targets
